sections.subhead: Keeping a Live Site Secure, Fast, and Actually Working

body.html: WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi is what Teknoppy provides once your site is live and needs to stay that way — updates applied without breaking things, backups that actually restore, and someone watching for problems before a customer finds them first. A WordPress site isn't a one-time build. Core software, themes, and plugins all change on their own schedules, and each change is a small chance something stops working. That's the gap this service closes — ongoing, hands-on upkeep instead of a site left to quietly drift out of date.

Businesses across Kochi increasingly learn this the hard way — a hacked login page, a plugin update that broke checkout, a site that's been down for hours before anyone noticed. WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi work exists to catch that before it costs you traffic, rankings, or a customer. Without a dedicated WordPress website update service in place, most sites simply accumulate risk quietly in the background until something forces the issue.

ctas.label: Book a Free Site Health Check

items.title: Core, Theme & Plugin Updates
items.html: Outdated plugins are the most common way WordPress sites get compromised. Our WordPress plugin update service runs on a fixed schedule, tested on a staging copy before anything touches your live site — so an update never becomes the reason your site goes down.

items.title: Daily Backups & Restore
items.html: Every site on a maintenance plan gets a WordPress backup and restore service running daily, stored off-server, with a restore process we've actually tested — not just configured and forgotten. A backup that's never been restored isn't a real safety net.

items.title: Security Monitoring
items.html: WordPress security monitoring Kochi work runs continuously, watching for malware injections, brute-force login attempts, and unauthorized file changes. Most attacks on small business sites are automated and opportunistic, which is exactly why continuous monitoring catches what a monthly check would miss.

items.title: Uptime Monitoring
items.html: Our WordPress uptime monitoring service checks your site every few minutes. If it goes down, we know before your customers do, and before it shows up as a drop in enquiries you can't immediately explain.

items.title: Site Health Audit
items.text: Before onboarding, we review current plugin versions, backup status, and any existing vulnerabilities so we know exactly what state the site is in.

items.title: Plan Setup
items.text: Daily backups, security monitoring, and uptime checks are switched on from day one, matched to one of our WordPress care plans Kochi businesses typically choose based on site size and traffic.

items.title: Scheduled Updates
items.text: Core, theme, and plugin updates are tested on staging first, then pushed live on a fixed schedule rather than an ad-hoc basis.

items.title: Ongoing Troubleshooting
items.text: Any broken layout, plugin conflict, or error is handled as part of WordPress bug fixing and troubleshooting, included in the plan rather than billed separately.

items.title: Monthly Reporting
items.text: You get a plain-language summary of what was updated, checked, and fixed that month, so maintenance isn't a black box.

outro.text: This is also the right service for businesses whose site sees regular traffic from outside Kerala — including GCC clients — where downtime during off-hours for you can still mean lost enquiries somewhere else. A site that isn't maintained doesn't fail all at once; it degrades gradually through slower load times, small visual bugs, and growing security gaps until one of them causes real damage.

outro.html: If your need is closer to a one-time fix than ongoing support, our WordPress Speed Optimization page covers that separately. If your site needs custom functionality built first, see Custom WordPress Development Kochi.

Businesses considering WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi usually fall into one of these categories rather than needing a full rebuild — which is why a short site health check comes before any quote.

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy manages ongoing WordPress maintenance for businesses across Kochi and Kerala — from small business sites to ecommerce stores — each on a monitored update and backup schedule. See related work in our Website Projects Portfolio.

Because every WordPress care plan is scoped to the site's size and traffic, pricing depends on how much monitoring and support your site actually needs. A small brochure site typically needs less active monitoring than an ecommerce store processing daily orders, so plans are priced accordingly rather than sold as one fixed package. For an estimate based on your specific site, use our Website Cost Calculator or Request a Quote.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi

items.q: What does WordPress maintenance service include?
items.a: It includes regular core, theme, and plugin updates, daily backups, security monitoring, and uptime checks — everything needed to keep a live WordPress site secure and functional. WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi plans also include ongoing bug fixes as part of the service, not billed separately.

items.q: How much does WordPress maintenance cost in Kochi?
items.a: It depends on site size, traffic, and whether ecommerce functionality is involved. A simple business site costs less than a high-traffic store needing more frequent monitoring and support.

items.q: How often should a WordPress site be updated?
items.a: Security patches should be applied immediately when released. Plugin and theme updates are typically reviewed and tested on staging monthly as part of a standard update cycle.

items.q: Do you offer emergency WordPress support?
items.a: Yes. Emergency WordPress support Kochi is available to clients on a maintenance plan if a site goes down, gets hacked, or stops functioning unexpectedly.

items.q: Who maintains the site if we already have an in-house developer?
items.a: You can keep maintenance in-house, or hand specific parts — backups, security monitoring, or update management — to us. Either way, we document changes so nothing depends on us alone.
